text:
Asha Rao: Quick heads-up: I'm updating the Optimize toolkit docs to include a short section on interactions between batching, kv cache ttl, and low-bit quant profiles. Found a non-obvious perf regression in our internal benchmark.

Benji Carter: Curious  details? Was it a quant-related tokenization shift or cache eviction pattern?

Asha Rao: Both kinda. Repro: medium-length prompts with continuous batching + kv prefetch + quant_profile=qs8 (aggressive). When cache_ttl small (<=30s) combined with batch_size 16 we see higher tail latency and more misses. Suspect prefetch windows collide with eviction.

Rina Gupta: Can you share the minimal example snippet you'll add? Good to have cross-sdk parity.

Asha Rao: Draft python snippet (to include in docs):

```python
from redwood import OptimizeClient
client = OptimizeClient()
inputs = [{"input": "contextual prompt {}".format(i)} for i in range(32)]
resp = client.generate_batch(
    model="open-qs8-v2",
    inputs=inputs,
    batch_size=16,
    use_kv_prefetch=True,
    kv_prefetch_batch_size=6,
    cache_ttl=120,  # increase ttl to avoid mid-batch evicts
    quant_profile="qs8"
)
print(resp.metrics.cache_hits, resp.metrics.cache_misses)
```

Benji Carter: LGTM. Suggest adding a short Kotlin snippet too  some of our mobile partners use it. Keep it tiny.

Asha Rao: Good call. Draft Kotlin example for SDK v0.9: 

```kotlin
val client = OptimizeClient()
val inputs = (0 until 32).map { mapOf("input" to "ctx $it") }
client.generateBatch(
  model = "open-qs8-v2",
  inputs = inputs,
  batchSize = 16,
  useKvPrefetch = true,
  kvPrefetchBatchSize = minOf(6, 16),
  cacheTtlSeconds = 120,
  quantProfile = "qs8"
)
```

Rina Gupta: Nice. Add a callout: "If using short cache_ttl values for memory pressure, reduce kv_prefetch_batch_size proportionally (eg kv_prefetch_batch_size <= max(4, batch_size/3))."

Asha Rao: Will do. Planning to add the rule to Optimize Troubleshooting FAQ and to the migration checklist: "When switching quant profiles, run kv-prefetch smoke test and verify cache_hit_ratio >= 80%". Thoughts?

Evan Miles: +1 on checklist. Also add a tiny CI example that runs the mocked repro and asserts metric thresholds. We had regressions slip by before.

Benji Carter: Can we also include a short graf in the docs explaining why qs8/qs4 change KV cache alignment? High-level note: different quant kernels can alter decode timing and chunking which our prefetch heuristics assume. Keep non-technical.

Asha Rao: Added a 2-sentence explainer: "Low-bit quant kernels may alter token decode alignment and prefetch chunk boundaries, which can make previously safe prefetch sizing lead to cache churn. We recommend testing prefetch settings after quant changes."

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1503 "optimize: batching+kv cache faq + kotlin example" assigned to @AshaR, reviewers @Rina @Benji.

Rina Gupta: I'll review. Quick nit: in the Kotlin snippet use `cacheTtlSeconds = 180` in the docs example  more conservative default.

Asha Rao: Done. Updated snippet and PR body. Also added a short dashboard query to illustrate cache_hit_ratio by route: `sum(cache_hits) / sum(cache_hits + cache_misses)` with a 5m rollup.

Benji Carter: Add a screenshot of the dashboard and a short recommended alert: alert if hit_ratio < 0.75 for 10m.

Asha Rao: Added screenshot and alert suggestion.

Evan Miles: For the CI check, I'll add a harness under examples/ci/mock-metrics that runs the snippet with a fixed seed and fails if miss_rate > 0.2. Keeps it light.

Rina Gupta: One more: add a small migration-guide bullet under "Optimize migration" about verifying prefetch behavior when enabling aggressive quant profiles and include the Kotlin/Python snippets there.

Asha Rao: Added that bullet. Merging after approvals. Thanks for quick reviews.

Benji Carter: Great. After merge, can someone file a short note for the release notes for the Optimize toolkit v2.2? We should call out the new FAQ and Kotlin example.

docs-bot: PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1503  merged by @AshaR. Follow-up issue created: DOCS-4791 "surface kv-prefetch+quant guidance in release notes" assigned to @Benji.

Asha Rao: Merged and release note task created. Thanks all :tada:
